blocks_9: Spacing and alignment are inconsistent between screens: the search switcher close X sits 9 px below the search row, the shortcuts section headers have 41 px vs 28 px gaps, empty states sit at different heights (icon centre at y316 vs y340), a 'Meeting ended' system line sits 15 px under a message where other system lines get about 30 px, and group chat leaves an empty band of about 70 px above the first date divider

One orange accent does too many jobs: unread dots, nav badges, the selected-row bar, focus rings, mentions, quote bars, checkboxes, the send icon, primary buttons and meeting icons. That weakens it as a signal. In light mode the accent (#b4530a) reads as rust-brown, but dark mode's #e88c3e reads as tangerine, so the two themes have different personalities
On wide windows, Calendar and Calls cap content at about 720 px, and the header actions (Copy link/Join end at x1114) float mid-window. The detail panes look empty and unfinished

Settings dialog: the bottom scroll shadow renders as a hard grey band (#e5e5e5 line at y695) over half-hidden content, plus about 25 px of dead padding below it; it is a long single column with mixed control styles

Narrow and edge layouts are unpolished: in calls-narrow, names truncate to 'Dorothy Vaug…' against the call icons. Extreme-aspect image thumbnails in the composer are unreadable strips. The first-sync-empty sidebar is completely blank

Typographic texture: Inter's wide hyphen shows in 'On-call', 'go/no-go', 'Ad-hoc', 'sign-in' and 'open-source'. Line height jumps when a link is inline (24 px vs 20 px on the device-code card). Very small 11 pt caps labels are used heavily

top_issues.issue: Close button is not vertically aligned with the search field row
top_issues.evidence: search icon ink y115-130 and placeholder y117-130 (centre about 123), close X ink y127-136 (centre about 131.5): a 9 px offset
top_issues.fix: centre the X on the search row: same 44 px row height, align-items centre, or set the X top to y115

top_issues.issue: The bottom scroll shadow reads as a hard grey divider with clipped content and dead space beneath
top_issues.evidence: column at x600 y688-697: ffffff>f9f9f9>f1f1f1>e5e5e5 then ffffff; content clipped at y690; about 25 px empty padding to the dialog edge at y720
top_issues.fix: use a soft 12 px gradient from the surface colour at 0% to rgba(0,0,0,0.06), with no solid end line; end the scroll area 16 px above the dialog edge; or split settings into a left category list

top_issues.issue: On wide windows the content column is capped at about 720 px and header actions float mid-window
top_issues.evidence: calendar Copy link/Join end at x1114 in a 1280 window (166 px dead strip); the calls card ends at x1114; the detail pane has 2 rows of metadata
top_issues.fix: pin header actions to the right edge (24 px inset) and let detail cards fill up to 880 px; add attendees and description sections or a two-column detail layout

top_issues.issue: The single orange accent is overloaded and changes character between themes
top_issues.evidence: #b4530a (light) and #e88c3e (dark) are used for badges, unread dots, selection bars, focus rings, mentions, quote bars, checkboxes, send icon, primary buttons and meeting icons; three orange elements in view at once in group-chat. Light reads rust-brown, dark reads tangerine
top_issues.fix: keep orange for primary actions, focus and selection; make unread dots and badges a neutral-strong ink (#1b1c1f light / #e9e9ec dark) or a separate notification hue; make quote bars neutral (#b9bcc4 / #4d4f58); move the light accent toward #c25a0c for parity

top_issues.issue: Inconsistent vertical rhythm for system lines and short conversations
top_issues.evidence: group-chat: 70 px empty band between header (y52) and first divider (y122); call-bar: 'Meeting ended' baseline 15 px under the last message vs about 30 px before other system lines; call-docked: 170 px empty above 'This is the beginning'
top_issues.fix: use a fixed 24 px gap above and below every system line and date divider; top-anchor short histories with 24 px padding under the header, or keep bottom anchoring but drop the extra leading spacer

top_issues.issue: Section header to first row spacing differs between sections
top_issues.evidence: NAVIGATION header y165 to first chip y193 top (about 41 px between centres) vs APP y348 to first chip y363 (about 28 px)
top_issues.fix: use one rule: 8 px from header baseline to first row and 20 px above each section header

top_issues.issue: Empty states are inconsistent and the first-run sidebar is blank
top_issues.evidence: first-sync-empty icon centre y316 vs y340 on chat-no-selection/teams/loading; the sidebar has no filter and no content (x64-363 empty)
top_issues.fix: put the illustration at one fixed position (centre at 42% height); in the empty sidebar show a short 'No chats yet' line plus a New chat button, or keep the filter disabled

top_issues.issue: Narrow layouts keep the full sidebar and crowd the content
top_issues.evidence: at 760 px the list column is 230 px; 'Dorothy Vaug…' and 'Margaret Ha…' run into the call icons at x225; chat names truncate after 9-12 characters
top_issues.fix: below 900 px, shrink list avatars to 32 px and hide the video icon until hover, or collapse the list to 200 px; give names min 120 px before icons

top_issues.issue: Extreme-aspect thumbnails are unreadable and captions show pixel sizes
top_issues.evidence: a 3072x256 image renders as a 141x12 px strip inside a 144x96 tile; 256x3072 as a 10 px column
top_issues.fix: centre-crop thumbnails to fill the 144x96 tile (object-fit: cover) and show file name or size; keep dimensions for the viewer only

top_issues.issue: Accent-on-tint text and dots are right at the threshold
top_issues.evidence: mention name #b4530a on #fdf1e5 = 4.52:1; unread dot #b4530a on #f3f4f6 = 4.56:1; white on #b4530a = 5.02:1
top_issues.fix: use #a14a08 for accent text on tints (5.40:1 on #fdf1e5) and keep #b4530a for fills

top_issues.issue: Every channel post is a fully bordered card, so the stack feels boxy and heavy
top_issues.evidence: card borders #b9bcc4 on #ffffff (1.90:1) and #4d4f58 on #1a1b1f (2.11:1) on each post, plus inner dividers between post and replies
top_issues.fix: drop the outer borders to the divider token (#dfdfe3 / #303137) or use a 1-step surface (#f7f7f9 / #202125) with 12 px radius; keep 16 px between posts

top_issues.issue: The Fit/100% segmented control mixes two selection metaphors and is undersized
top_issues.evidence: selected segment has a grey fill and a 2 px orange underline inside a bordered pill; height 26 px next to a 20 pt title
top_issues.fix: use one selected style (filled #e2e3e8 / #34353c with 600 weight, no underline), with 28 px height and 12 px horizontal padding

top_issues.issue: The hover tooltip spills over the card border and covers content
top_issues.evidence: the tooltip box at x601-900, y446-493 crosses the card's right edge at x874 and covers the App registration row
top_issues.fix: place the tooltip above the button or clamp it inside the card; or show the explanation as a 12 pt helper line under the buttons

top_issues.issue: The wide hyphen and inline-link line height break the text texture
top_issues.evidence: 'On-call', 'go/no-go', 'Ad-hoc', 'sign-in' and 'open-source' show visibly spaced hyphens; the device-code paragraph line pitch is 24 px vs 20 px in other 14 pt paragraphs
top_issues.fix: use U+2011 or tighten the hyphen in the bundled font (or enable Inter's 'case'/'ss' features); give links the same line height as surrounding text

top_issues.issue: The brand block sits at different heights and sizes across onboarding screens
top_issues.evidence: setup logo top at y26 (smaller lockup); sign-in at y124; signin-failed at y145; the lockup height differs (about 60 px vs about 90 px)
top_issues.fix: use one lockup size (72 px) and centre the whole stack vertically, with a 32 px min top margin for tall forms

top_issues.issue: Account menu identity is ambiguous and the rail avatar carries an unexplained orange dot
top_issues.evidence: two rows both 'Alex Rivera' differ only in a grey 13 pt email; the rail avatar has both a presence dot (bottom-right) and an orange dot (top-right)
top_issues.fix: show the tenant or org name as the second line (Contoso / Fabrikam) and the email as a tooltip; label the orange dot via a badge count matching the menu ('1')
